items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: Coach/practice progress on hip/groin; Schefter confirmation alongside Donald OUT.
items.implication: Nacua returns as WR1; Davante Adams volume likely regresses from recent spike.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; reverse any Adams over-reliance.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle. Official final injury report confirms OUT.
items.why: Sprained ankle from Week 3; no practice this week; official ruling.
items.implication: Jordan Addison elevated to WR1/2 role vs MIA; Vikings may lean run-heavy.
items.opportunity: Full target share to Addison and other WRs; check snap/route data for Addison.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; no practice; week-to-week but confirmed out.
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead back; high-volume RB2 upside vs CHI.
items.opportunity: Nearly all RB snaps/carries/targets to Allen (and Isaiah Davis mix); Wilson already high target share with Mitchell out.

items.text: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday. Marcus Mariota will start vs Colts in London.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation recovery; practiced limited but not ready; coach confirmation.
items.implication: Mariota streams as QB with solid floor vs IND pass D; WAS pass catchers (McLaurin/Diggs) still viable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Mariota designed runs possible; monitor McLaurin Q status impact.

items.text: Terry McLaurin added to injury report with hamstring; limited Friday, questionable vs Colts. New issue popped up in practice.
items.why: Hamstring issue in Friday practice; sudden addition to report.
items.implication: Risky start; if out, Diggs/others absorb targets behind Mariota.
items.opportunity: Monitor final inactive; beneficiaries if OUT would be Diggs/Williams.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% when Sampson healthy). On pace for 64 catches after 26 last year.
items.why: 4-game sample with Sampson absent driving higher receiving role.
items.implication: Judkins more PPR viable as pass-catching RB; elevated ROS outlook.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share, pace for significant receptions; monitor if Sampson returns.

items.text: Nico Collins returned to practice (limited then progressing), optimistic/trending toward Week 4 return vs DAL after multi-week hamstring. Stroud efficiency spikes with him.
items.why: Practice return + player/coach optimism; Grade 1 prior.
items.implication: WR1 if active; major upgrade for HOU offense/Stroud.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; reverse any temporary WR beneficiaries.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play: 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game.
items.why: Full workhorse role (snaps/touches) + favorable matchup on short week TNF.
items.implication: High-end RB2/flex start with volume security.
items.opportunity: 90% snaps, near-monopoly on carries/targets; Dowdle OUT again.

items.text: Drake London LOVE: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Hyper-targeted by Penix + soft WR TD matchup.
items.implication: WR1 play with massive volume ceiling.
items.opportunity: Elite target share and aDOT with Penix under center.

items.text: Garrett Wilson LOVE @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined. 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Clear WR1 volume with Mitchell OUT + favorable secondary.
items.implication: Strong WR2/1 upside; confirmed Mitchell OUT boosts further.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes with thin WR room.

items.text: Fresh ETR Rest of Season Rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked #3 overall notable. Also Parker Washington #22, Saquon #30.
items.why: Usage/role and remaining schedule driving high ROS placement.
items.opportunity: Featured role and efficiency supporting top-tier projection.

items.text: Omarion Hampton on Week 4 Hate List: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate dropped to 42%, only 13% third-down. SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Poor recent usage metrics + tough run defense matchup.
items.implication: Sit/fade; limited upside even in decent script.

items.text: Josh Downs LOVE vs WSH: 31% target share last two games, 43% red-zone looks. WAS allows most FP and TDs to WRs/slot.
items.why: Presumptive No. 1 with Pierce IR; elite red-zone + matchup.
items.implication: WR2/3 start with TD upside in London game.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share as lead option.

items.text: Kyle Pitts HATE @ NO: Just 16% target share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Persistent low targets/aDOT underperformance with Penix.
items.opportunity: Low tgt share and red-zone neglect confirmed by Levitan notes too.
